name: Michigan
eyebrow: DTE · Consumers · Lansing BWL · Ann Arbor
short: Michigan has no single statewide utility rebate, so your city and your utility decide. Ann Arbor's city program pays $4,000 for a cold climate heat pump ($5,500 for lower incomes). Lansing's Board of Water & Light pays $4,000 to $5,000 when a heat pump replaces a gas furnace. DTE Energy pays up to $600 for attic insulation and $100 to $400 for a gas furnace, and Consumers Energy pays up to $475 for insulation. The state's own MiHER rebates are paused for new income-qualified applications in five districts, and the federal tax credits ended after 2025.
